text:
alex: Heads-up — vendor roadmap sync with NVIDIA, AMD, and Habana next Tue 9am PT. We need to lock public announcement windows and technical handoffs for H100/H200, MI300, Gaudi, and B200. Who should be on the call? :calendar:

maria: I can be there. Product needs exact release windows so marketplace listings and pre-reqs (images, AMIs, pricing tiers) are ready.

sam: Ops will join. Current capacity estimate: H100 Q2 limited, H200 early Q3, MI300 varies by region. We should flag dedicated pool constraints.

jia: Partnerships here — vendors asked for a single coordinated timeline to avoid multiple press bursts. They also want SI integration cutover dates for early adopters.

tariq: Legal/comms note: vendors are requesting a 48-hour embargo before any joint announcement. Also need to confirm logo/asset approval process.

alex: Good — can someone draft a minimal timeline matrix we can share in the sync? I want columns: vendor, model, earliest GA, recommended marketplace publish, SI integration milestone, embargo window.

sam: Quick draft attached in thread (paste):
```
NVIDIA - H100: earliest GA Q2 week 3, marketplace publish Q2 week 4, SI pilot Q2 week 6, embargo 48h
NVIDIA - H200: earliest GA Q3 week 1, marketplace publish Q3 week 2, SI pilot Q3 week 4, embargo 48h
AMD - MI300: earliest GA Q3 week 2 (region stagger), marketplace publish Q3 week 3, SI pilot Q3 week 6, embargo 72h
Habana - Gaudi/B200: earliest GA Q2 week 5, marketplace publish Q2 week 6, SI pilot Q2 week 8, embargo 72h
```

jia: That looks good as a starting point. I'll confirm vendor embargo preferences and ask for the final GA dates.

maria: Product asks we also mark recommended quantization/instance types per model so release notes don't cause support churn.

alex: Agreed. Sam — can you add a 'capacity risk' column (low/med/high) and an action item per row (e.g., reserve Dedicated pools, schedule extra CI runs)?

sam: Yup. I'll update before EOD and post a single slide we can share with vendor PMs.

devops-bot: Reminder: infrastructure change freeze window on 1893570000-1893580000 (scheduled maintenance) — avoid publishing during that timeframe.

jia: Nice catch — add the infra freeze into the timeline. We'll ask vendors for flexibility around that window.

tariq: I'll draft the comms checklist (assets, embargo, spokespersons, SI case studies) and share in #marketing once we have final dates.

alex: Thanks everyone. Final: invite list for Tues call — @maria, @sam, @jia, @tariq, vendor PMs (I'll ping them), and one SRE rep. If anyone else should be added, flag now. :thumbsup:
